name: Ohio Northern University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate. 2025-26 tuition & fees from onu.edu/admissions-aid/financial-aid/tuition-and-fees: Arts & Sciences/Business tuition $39,970 + $1,500 general student fee = $41,470 (Engineering and Pharmacy are higher). Housing: room-only Suite Double/Triple (Lima/Roberts/Brookhart) $7,700 for 2025-26 (room only, board not included; other room-only options range $7,200-$11,550; standard freshman room+board with 19-meal plan is $13,750).
